critical_code_review_comments: host_migration_routes.py cleanly enforces the step-up gate before contacting the sidecar for start/freeze/decommission/abort (cutover_check + retry correctly skipped). Input validation is regex-based and applied before the sidecar call — good defense in depth against shell injection into ssh/rsync commands. All endpoints require admin. _call() maps sidecar 409 → 409 and other errors → 502 — correct semantics.

deploy/migrator/migrator.py stdlib-only sidecar, HMAC-safe token compare, state persisted atomically via tmp+rename. simulated_run() gives deterministic dry-run output; cutover heartbeats are gated on time.time()%60>20 so real retries are exercised. Nice.
AdminHostMigration.jsx polls every 4s; consider stopping the polling when tab is hidden to save resources (document.visibilityState). Non-blocking.
